info.description: Read your brand's catalog, sourcing, orders, shipments, finance, and documents. All business endpoints are read-only and require an API key. Products are Parent Products; Product Options and SKUs are separate resources. Use filters to find records, follow their IDs to related data, and paginate to retrieve every result. See the [integration tutorials](https://docs.amber.ai/index#build-an-integration) for complete examples and [data conventions](https://docs.amber.ai/pagination#data-conventions) for amounts, IDs, and timestamps.
